I have successfully rebuilt and run the SESANS instrument in McStas with the requested parameters ($L_0 = 2.165$ Å, $\Delta\lambda = 0.02$ Å, $B_y = 0.00468$ T) using $1,000,000$ rays (`ncount=1e6`) and `seed=42`. 

Below is the summary of the integrated intensity ($I$), statistical error ($\pm \text{err}$), and event count ($N$) for every monitor in the beamline:

| Monitor Name | Component Type | Integrated Intensity ($I$) | Error ($\pm \text{err}$) | Event Count ($N$) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`px1`** | `PolLambda_monitor` | $5.39818 \times 10^{-7}$ | $6.53083 \times 10^{-10}$ | $683,216$ |
| **`px2`** | `PolLambda_monitor` | $5.39818 \times 10^{-7}$ | $6.53083 \times 10^{-10}$ | $683,216$ |
| **`px3`** | `PolLambda_monitor` | $5.39818 \times 10^{-7}$ | $6.53083 \times 10^{-10}$ | $683,216$ |
| **`px6`** | `PolLambda_monitor` | $5.37403 \times 10^{-7}$ | $1.06103 \times 10^{-9}$ | $651,210$ |
| **`det`** | `PSD_monitor` | $1.18661 \times 10^{-7}$ | $4.31903 \times 10^{-10}$ | $287,012$ |
| **`det2`** | `PSD_monitor` | $0.0$ | $0.0$ | $0$ |

### Notes on Simulation Results:
- **Monitors `px1`, `px2`, and `px3`** show identical intensities because they use `restore_neutron=1`, capturing the unperturbed beam state at different points along the upstream section before and between the magnetic flippers.
- **Monitor `px6`** shows a slight decrease in intensity due to scattering and attenuation through the downstream sample (`sans_spheres`) and flippers.
- **`det`** records the scattered and analyzed beam passing through the ideal analyzer with $m_x = 1$.
- **`det2`** records zero events because the preceding `trick` component restores the neutron state for the second analyzer branch (`ana2` with $m_x = -1$), which filters out the orthogonal polarization state relative to the chosen incoming polarization.
